verdict.rationale: Hightouch offers Git Sync for managing workspace resources (including syncs/audiences) programmatically, and community comparison explicitly cites 'git version control' as a differentiator, which supports versioning. However, there's no direct documentation of a review workflow or an explicit rollback mechanism for automations—only sync run debugging and failure alerts are documented. missing for 10: explicit rollback UI/feature, formal review/approval workflow tied to version history, independent confirmation of rollback in practice.
